name: Maritime forest
notes: Salt-pruned coastal forest just behind the dunes: wind-sheared live oaks, pines, palmettos or cypresses over a dense evergreen shrub thicket, with Spanish moss and resurrection fern on the limbs; drawn on the US Atlantic/Gulf barrier islands, Monterey coast and Japanese/Hokkaido shorelines.

canopy.name: Bald cypress

growth.juvenile_note: Epigeal: 3-9 (usually 6) cotyledons, then soft, flat, feathery needles in two ranks on deciduous side shoots; seedlings grow 20-75 cm in their first year if not flooded over. America (seedlings 20-75 cm in year 1; soil saturated but not flooded 1-3 months for germination; intermediate shade tolerance; height growth stops ~200 yr); Wikipedia (3 m at 5 yr, 21 m at 41 yr, 36 m at 96 yr; seed from ~30 yr; 3-9 cotyledons; Black River tree at least 2,624 yr old).
